scientific_question: Can one fixed-budget, truth-free, per-observation supplement to the sealed QDEIM anchors remove the v190 normal-metric failure on the already-open four-frame development roster?
role: post-open development capacity diagnostic; it tests one deterministic observation-adaptive coordinate subset and one cheaper observation-only control, not a trained predictor or a deployable cost claim

already_seen: v189 full camera-resolved DCT K1 is strict-safe in 52/52 five-camera and 52/52 all-nine cells
v190 fixed geometry-only QDEIM1280 K1 is strict-safe in 35/52 five-camera and 30/52 all-nine cells
v191.1 attributes the v190 failure to observation-activated normal-metric distortion, with about 91%-94% median coordinate-error response energy in discarded columns
not_read_or_computed_before_this_freeze: any v192 coordinate, field, physical K1 replay or metric
any v192 control or primary pass count
pre_result_disclosure.claim_boundary: The same four frames are already open development data. A pass can establish only mechanism headroom on this roster; it cannot establish complete-trajectory accuracy, resource savings, external generalization or real BOST.

data_isolation.development_roster: the same p=22kw_size=01 frames 0,25,75,100, 13 frozen calibrations, five-camera and all-nine arms used by v189-v191
data_isolation.prediction_inputs: sealed v189 full camera-resolved detector-potential DCT features plus a response matrix rebuilt only from the frozen affine basis and reported geometry
forbidden_inputs: CFD truth, field metrics or v189/v190 pass masks inside selection, score, normalization, tie-break or fallback
frame index, trajectory identity, time, power or size as a selection feature
PoolFire validation, stopping-validation or test trajectories
real BOST, external data, post-result thresholds, alternate budgets, regularizers, candidate search or learned predictors
data_isolation.truth_use: only after all selected indices, coordinates and initial fields are sealed, to synthesize the already-open vector observations for unchanged physical K1 replay and to compute frozen metrics

fixed_representation.canonical_feature_space: all 575 non-DC 24x24 detector-potential DCT modes per active camera, concatenated after sorting the reported camera IDs
fixed_representation.anchors: the exact geometry-only QDEIM anchor indices sealed by v190; formal execution also rebuilds and verifies them before consuming heldout features
fixed_representation.anchor_coordinate: for each observation row h, compute c_anchor as the Moore-Penrose least-squares solution of c H_anchor = h_anchor using float64 SVD, relative singular floor sqrt(float64 epsilon), and require retained rank 1009
fixed_representation.primary_score: for every non-anchor canonical column j, score_j = abs((c_anchor H_full - h_full)_j) * norm(H_full[:,j],2)
fixed_representation.primary_interpretation: the Euclidean norm of that column's vector contribution to the full normal-equation defect
fixed_representation.cheap_control_score: for every non-anchor canonical column j, score_j = abs(h_full_j)
fixed_representation.ranking: descending score with the smaller canonical full-DCT feature index as the only tie-break
fixed_representation.selection: take exactly the first 271 ranked non-anchor columns, union them with all 1009 anchors, then sort the 1280 canonical indices
fixed_representation.final_coordinate: independently solve c H_selected = h_selected by the same frozen float64 Moore-Penrose rule; no ridge, reweighting, line search, fallback or candidate choice
fixed_representation.camera_permutation_contract: permuting input camera or ray order must leave the canonical response, scores, selected canonical feature identities, coordinates and fields unchanged within the frozen numerical tolerances
fixed_representation.variable_cardinality_contract: the same code and constants must natively process both five and nine active cameras

evaluation.physical_replay: construct the affine field from the selected coordinate, then apply the exact unchanged v189/v190 one-step CGLS refinement

cost_boundary.dense_online_work_disclosed: both new selectors read the complete per-camera DCT observation feature vector; the primary also scans the complete cached geometry response and computes a full anchor residual
cost_boundary.geometry_cache_disclosed: all full response matrices and QDEIM anchors are geometry-derived setup artifacts; their construction is offline and is not erased from whole-pipeline accounting
cost_boundary.forbidden_claim: A fixed 1280-column solve budget does not establish lower wall time, lower memory or fewer complete-pipeline operations because dense feature and response scans remain.

required_validity_gates: all v189, v190 and v191.1 parent hashes and tree seals remain unchanged
the response and v190 anchor reconstruction match the sealed parent within 1e-8 and exactly for discrete indices
every anchor and final selected response retains rank 1009 and every final solve has stationarity at most 1e-7
all selected rosters contain 1009 exact anchors plus 271 unique non-anchor supplements, are sorted and in range
selection APIs expose no truth, trajectory, frame, time, power or size argument
mutating the heldout truth after fixing observation features changes no selection, coordinate or initial field
camera/ray permutation preserves canonical features, scores, selections, coordinates and fields
all four new arms physically replay their exact declared calls with no CGLS breakdown
all candidate fields, metrics, scores and audits are finite and have frozen shapes
formal source and all bound inputs remain unchanged
the independent implementation rebuilds features, responses, anchors, scores, selections, solves, physical replay and metrics without importing the formal v192 module or runner
fixed_decision_order: Any binding, isolation, rank, stationarity, selection, noninterference, permutation, replay, call, finite, shape, source or independent-comparison failure makes v192 inconclusive.

If normal_contribution_qdeim1280_k1 fails any of the 104 strict cells, conclude FAIL_NORMAL_CONTRIBUTION_OBSERVATION_ADAPTIVE_QDEIM_CAPACITY_V192 and close this exact score-and-budget mechanism; do not increase budget or rescue it with a learned model.

If the primary passes all 104 strict cells and observation_magnitude_qdeim1280_k1 also passes all 104, conclude PASS_CHEAP_OBSERVATION_MAGNITUDE_CORESET_HEADROOM_V192; any follow-up must prefer and separately test the cheaper control.
If the primary passes all 104 strict cells and the cheap control does not, conclude PASS_NORMAL_CONTRIBUTION_OBSERVATION_ADAPTIVE_QDEIM_HEADROOM_V192.

A passing capacity result authorizes only one separately frozen complete-trajectory development gate for the winning deterministic mechanism. It does not authorize predictor training or resource claims.

must_rebuild: the complete per-camera DCT observation features from the already-open raw field observations
all 26 geometry response matrices and 26 QDEIM anchor rosters
all 208 control/primary per-frame score vectors and selected rosters
all anchor and final coordinates with an independent LAPACK driver
all initial fields, unchanged physical K1 fields, exact call receipts and strict metrics
all parent and input seals before and after validation

authorization_boundary.if_independent_capacity_passes: authorize only a separately frozen complete-trajectory development replay of the winning deterministic observation-adaptive mechanism
authorization_boundary.if_primary_fails: close this exact normal-contribution supplement and do not change budget, score, regularization or model size after seeing the result
not_authorized: CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or larger-model rescue
opening PoolFire validation/test or an external gate
